facts.claim: Nova Support Platform is an internal customer-support system developed by NovaTech Solutions.
The platform is designed to help support agents manage customer tickets, track incidents, and monitor response times.
The project began in January 2024.
The original completion date was December 2024.
The first internal prototype was completed in April 2024.
The beta release was scheduled for September 2024.
An October 2024 update says the beta had already been released in August 2024.
An internal note says the beta release was delayed until October 2024 due to database performance problems.
The January staffing report listed 17 members: 12 developers, 3 designers, and 2 project managers.
The June report states the team grew to 21 members after four engineers and two testers joined.
A management summary states the team consisted of 18 people at its peak.
The November personnel report lists 20 active members.
The approved project budget was $480,000.
Finance recorded an expenditure of $310,000 by the end of August 2024.
A September financial summary reports total spending of $365,000.
The annual review states the project had spent $410,000 by the end of July 2024.
The annual review estimates the final project cost will be approximately $525,000.
The first performance test reported an average ticket-processing time of 4.2 seconds.
A July engineering report recorded an average processing time of 3.8 seconds.
An August report claimed the average processing time fell to 2.1 seconds after optimization.
A September customer-support survey reported an average processing time of approximately 5 seconds.
The engineering team attributed performance problems to inefficient database queries.
In October 2024, the security team investigated an unauthorized access incident.
The incident report states the event occurred on October 14 and affected 37 customer accounts.
The management summary states the incident occurred on October 12 and affected 27 accounts.
The security team concluded compromised employee credentials were used to gain access.
No evidence of customer password theft was found.
The December project report states the platform was ready for production deployment.
An engineering note from December says several critical performance issues remained unresolved.
The product manager's final update describes the project as successfully completed in December 2024.
An operations document says the production launch was postponed until February 2025.
